The '''National Statistics and Information Authority''' ('''NSIA''', {{langx|prs|اداره ملی احصائیه و معلومات}}; {{langx|ps|د احصایې او معلوماتو ملي اداره}}), formerly known by other names such the '''Central Statistics Office''' ({{langx|prs|ادارۀ مرکزی احصائیه}}; {{langx|ps|د احصایې او معلوماتو ملي اداره}}), is a government agency in [[Afghanistan]] that collects and maintains the country's statistical data.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://pajhwok.com/2025/10/31/global-national-figures-differ-afghanistans-exact-population-remains-unclear/ |title=Global, national figures differ; Afghanistan's exact population remains unclear |work=Pajhwok Afghan News |date=31 October 2025 |access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref> It was established in 1972.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://nsia.gov.af/about-us/about-nsia|title=About Us|publisher=National Statistics and Information Authority|access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref> Abdul Qahir Haji Edris serves as NSIA's General Director.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://pajhwok.com/2025/07/29/nsia-reveals-last-years-major-achievements/ |title=NSIA reveals last year's major achievements |work=Pajhwok Afghan News |date=29 July 2025 |access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref>

NSIA's Civil Registration and Foreign Nationals Registration Department is responsible for registering [[citizens of Afghanistan]] in its national database, and providing them with documents such as [[Afghan identity card|national ID cards]], [[birth certificate]]s, [[death certificate]]s, [[marriage certificate]]s, etc.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://pajhwok.com/2025/09/23/nsia-cuts-id-card-issuance-fee-for-overseas-afghans/ |title=NSIA cuts ID card issuance fee for overseas Afghans |work=Pajhwok Afghan News |date=23 September 2025 |access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref> NSIA has branches in all [[provinces of Afghanistan]] and in the [[United Arab Emirates]] but its main offices are in [[Kabul]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-196585 |title=NSIA Distributes Over 10 Million E-ID Cards |work=TOLOnews |date=14 November 2025 |access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref> 

NSIA's Civil Registration and Foreign Nationals Registration Department also keeps records of all foreign travelers entering and leaving Afghanistan.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://pajhwok.com/2026/01/27/over-2000-foreigners-enter-exit-afghanistan-last-month-nsia/ |title=Over 2,000 foreigners enter, exit Afghanistan last month: NSIA |work=Pajhwok Afghan News |date=27 January 2026 |access-date=2026-01-27}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.ariananews.af/over-5000-foreign-nationals-traveled-to-afghanistan-in-past-two-months-nsia/ |title=Over 5,000 foreign nationals traveled to Afghanistan in past two months: NSIA |work=Ariana News |date=27 May 2025 |access-date=2025-12-22}}</ref> The NSIA works closely with the nation's [[Ministry of Interior Affairs (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Interior Affairs]] but is not a part of it.
